Example ADSL dataset

adsl.Rd

A processed Subject-Level Analysis Dataset (ADSL) used throughout the examples and vignettes of anaume. It is derived from the CDISC pilot dummy data shipped with the pharmaverseadam package and restricted to the safety population (SAFFL == "Y"). It serves as the denominator dataset when building adverse event summaries.

Usage

adsl

Format

A tibble with 254 rows and 55 variables. Key variables include:

USUBJID

Unique subject identifier.

TRT01A

Actual treatment arm.

ARM

Planned treatment arm.

ACTARM

Actual treatment arm description.

SAFFL

Safety population flag ("Y"/"N").

AGE

Age in years.

SEX

Sex ("F"/"M").

Additional CDISC ADaM standard variables are also included.

Source

Derived from the pharmaverseadam package using the preprocessing script data-raw/adamdummy.R.
